en.title: Ready-made templates
en.lead: Pick a template; you can change its values before you set it up.

pump.d: Tells you when any coin rises 5% or more within 5 minutes.
pump.s: If {subject} rises {percent} or more within {minutes} minutes, send {channel}.

pumpVolume.d: Catches sharp rises backed by volume and filters out thin spikes.
pumpVolume.s: If {subject} rises {percent} or more within {minutes} minutes and its volume tops {multiplier}× the average, send {channel}.

dump.d: Tells you when any coin falls 5% or more within 5 minutes.
dump.s: If {subject} falls {percent} or more within {minutes} minutes, send {channel}.

oversold.d: Tells you when your coin enters the oversold zone.
oversold.s: If RSI(14) of {subject} drops below {level} on the {timeframe} chart, send {channel}.

overbought.d: Tells you when your coin overheats and enters the overbought zone.
overbought.s: If RSI(14) of {subject} rises above {level} on the {timeframe} chart, send {channel}.

emaCross.d: When the short-term average crosses above the long-term one; a possible trend reversal.
emaCross.s: If EMA {fast} crosses above EMA {slow} on the {timeframe} chart of {subject}, send {channel}.

dropOversold.d: When a fast drop and oversold come together; for buying the dip.
dropOversold.s: If {subject} falls {percent} or more within {minutes} minutes while RSI(14) is below {level} on the {timeframe} chart, send {channel}.

rsiScan.d: Finds coins across the market whose RSI drops below 25.
rsiScan.s: If RSI(14) of {subject} drops below {level} on the {timeframe} chart, send {channel}.

coinRise.d: Tells you when your coin rises 5% or more within an hour.

dayHigh.d: Tells you when the price breaks above the highest level of the last 24 hours.
dayHigh.s: If {subject} breaks above its 24-hour high, send {channel}.

priceAbove.d: Tells you when the coin rises to the price you set.

priceBelow.d: Tells you when the coin falls to the price you set.
